headline: Quiet day: DeepSeek's Harness agent app hits 1.54 million users
body: A quiet Sunday with one event. DeepSeek's Harness agent app reached 1.54 million daily users, lifting AI Autonomy by 0.16. Zookeeper and Conquerors edged up and Enslaved God slipped. Horizon Balance was almost unchanged at -18.51, from -18.49.
movers_note: Enslaved God -0.10, partly from the Harness milestone (-0.05). Zookeeper +0.09, from Harness (+0.10). Conquerors +0.08, from Harness (+0.08).
coming_up: Meta shuts down the Conductor cloud service, 20 Nov
